answer_1.quote: We propose a novel framework for metaphor generation informed by conceptual metaphor theory.

answer_2.quote: We employ semantic distance metrics. We generate sentence embeddings using SBERT for each of our components: the literal input L, the original gold metaphoric expression M, and the generated output G. ... we can evaluate this using the cosine distance, here between M and G.
automatic_metrics: Cosine distance (SBERT embeddings) between generated and gold metaphor
Cosine distance (SBERT embeddings) between literal input and generated metaphor

answer_4.quote: We recruited three domain experts in metaphoricity. They were instructed to rate each instance on a scale from 1 (not at all) to 4 (very) for metaphoricity and for whether it evokes the source domain.
answer_4.guideline: Raters were provided with brief definitions of metaphoricity and links to FrameNet frames for domain evocation.
